forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A03 / Angular Security: bypassSecurityTrustHtml() disables Angular's built-in XSS sanitization for HTML.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Do not use bypassSecurityTrustHtml() with user-controlled content. If HTML rendering is required, sanitize with DomSanitizer after strict input validation and use only with trusted, static content.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A03 / Angular Security: bypassSecurityTrustScript() disables Angular's script sanitization and allows XSS.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Never pass user input to bypassSecurityTrustScript(). Avoid executing dynamic scripts; use Angular's component system instead.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A03: bypassSecurityTrustUrl() can enable javascript: URLs and open redirect vulnerabilities.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Validate URLs against a strict allowlist before using bypassSecurityTrustUrl(). Prefer relative URLs or Angular Router navigation.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A03: bypassSecurityTrustResourceUrl() can allow loading of malicious resources.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Validate resource URLs against a strict allowlist before using bypassSecurityTrustResourceUrl().

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A03: bypassSecurityTrustStyle() can enable CSS injection attacks.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Validate CSS values carefully. Avoid using bypassSecurityTrustStyle() with user-controlled values.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A03: Angular's [innerHTML] binding sanitizes HTML, but usage should be reviewed for trust mark bypass patterns.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Ensure bound value does not come from user input without sanitization. Prefer Angular template binding for plain text: [textContent].

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A02 / CIS Benchmark: Storing authentication tokens in localStorage exposes them to XSS attacks.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Store authentication tokens in HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite cookies via server-side session management.

forbidden_patterns.reason: FIPS 140-3 / NIST SP 800-90A: Math.random() is not cryptographically secure.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Use the Web Crypto API: crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32)) or crypto.randomUUID().

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A03: eval() enables arbitrary code execution.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Remove eval(). Angular's template engine should handle all dynamic rendering.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A07 / NIST IA-5: Hardcoded password detected in source code.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Remove hardcoded passwords. Use Angular environments with injection tokens and load secrets from secure backend APIs.
